text:
Priya (partnerships): Quick sync — prepping the joint launch playbook for Snowbridge + Databricks + Vector partners next month. Need a concise checklist: marketplace listing assets, partner-ready connector artifacts, HW bundle notes for DGX partners, SI handoff steps, and announcement cadence. Any must-haves? @Elena @Jordan

Elena (marketing): +1. We need the single-sheet marketplace tile copy, 2 screenshots (console + integration flow), and a short 45s demo clip. Also legal needs approval for the joint logo lockups.

Jordan (eng): For connector artifacts: working sample DAG, SQL snippet for Snowpipe ingestion, and a lightweight docker image with our sidecar. Also need clear matrix of supported model sizes/quantization for the bundle.

Sam (product): Can we standardize on a "minimum viable listing" so partners can go live quickly? Suggest: short description, one screenshot, quickstart link, and compatibility matrix. Everything else is optional.

Max (solutions): Field teams need a handoff doc: install checklist, common troubleshooting commands, and a troubleshooting playbook for telemetry gaps. I'll draft a template.

Priya (partnerships): Good. Timeline proposal: draft assets by T+7 days, internal review by T+11, partner legal sign-off by T+18, marketplace staging by T+21, soft-go w/partners T+28, public announce T+35. Thoughts?

Jordan (eng): T+7 is tight for the docker sidecar + sample DAG. Can we push to T+10 for engineering deliverables?

Elena (marketing): T+35 for public announce ok but recommend a stagger: marketplace listing + partner case study week 1, joint blog + webinar week 2. Gives partners runway for joint PR.

Sam (product): Agree with stagger. Also surface a rollback/fallback plan: if connector shows high CPU during initial 48h, auto-disable prefetch and route to hosted variant. Need ops runbook.

Max (solutions): I'll add the ops runbook appendix with the CPU thresholds and commands:
```
# ops quick commands
kubectl logs -f connector-deploy
curl -sS http://connector/healthz
rd-inferctl route set --variant hosted
```

Priya (partnerships): Perfect. Action items: Elena to own marketplace tile & demo clip; Jordan + Max to own connector artifacts & runbook; Sam to own rollback policy; Priya to coordinate partner sign-off and announcement dates. I'll book a 30m sync for tomorrow to walk the checklist.

deploy-bot: Reminder set for 24 hours before sync (channel: #partnerships).

Elena (marketing): I'll upload a draft tile copy to the partnership drive by EOD.

Jordan (eng): Will push a reference DAG + sidecar image to staging registry by EOD + 2 days.

Sam (product): I'll draft the rollback policy and share in thread by EOD + 3 days.

Priya (partnerships): Thanks team — aim to keep assets minimal and partner-friendly. If anyone hits blockers, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
